model_selection: same 136 frozen checkpoints as current_reference_test_v1; no Test-based selection
candidate_rules: same task-specific construction as frozen Development multistep_development_coverage_v2

metrics.complete_error_over_reference: matched free-running prediction error / condition-mean reference error
metrics.normalized_history_gain: (wrong-history error averaged across all other histories - matched-history error) / same reference error
metrics.response_nre: condition-centered response error / same reference error; multi-condition, five-horizon diagnostic

aggregation: average conditions/candidates/horizons per source query, sum query energies, ratio per checkpoint, equal-weight existing training repetitions
history_control: reuse each condition prediction against each other fixed target; valid only with matching current observation and identical context/future actions
